subject_notes: Space-infrastructure rollup of Hera Systems, Made In Space, Adcole, Roccor, Deployable Space Systems (Redwire Space Enterprises), Techshot (Redwire Space Technologies), Oakman Aerospace, LoadPath, and QinetiQ Space NV. Federal exposure is heavy on NASA (Artemis Orion Camera, ISS biotech/bioprinting), ESA (Hera, PROBA, Comet Interceptor), and ROSA solar arrays. Defense exposure is narrative-vague: Link-16 antennas, 'first generation national-security satellite constellation in LEO', and Space Force GPS heritage. Cohort thesis is SDA/AFRL contracting narrative — the 10-K does NOT name SDA Tranche, AFRL Quantum Networking, DARPA Blackjack/Mandrake, or any specific PE number / line-item the J-Book corpus could test directly. That absence is itself the disclosure pattern.
extraction_notes: FY2023 10-K narrative is product-portfolio-centric and cites mission heritage (Artemis, IXPE, DART, ISS) rather than DoD Program Elements. The only forward defense hooks are: (i) Link-16 antennas for NATO tactical data; (ii) 'first generation of a national security satellite constellation in LEO'; (iii) the cybersecurity NIST/DoD-aligned posture; (iv) reference to U.S. government contracts subject to audit. The Q2-2024 10-Q (filed 2024-08-08) adds: book-to-bill 1.47x Q2-2024 (vs 0.76x Q2-2023), Hera mission still active, and an unremediated material weakness in ICFR through 2024-06-30. Customer-concentration disclosure is absent from both filings — the 10-K does not name 10%-of-revenue customers in the Business section. Filings do not name SDA, AFRL Quantum, DARPA Blackjack, VICTUS, Tranche, Skyborg, Project Maven, CCA, or any 7-digit PE number, so the J-Book primary verifier will mostly return NOT_FOUND (UNVERIFIABLE) per heuristic rule 7.

claims.claim_text: Redwire's antennas, compatible with the Link-16 data link network used by NATO and other nations, are being used for the first generation of a national security satellite constellation in LEO.
claims.subject: Redwire (RF Systems)
claims.object_value: Link-16-compatible antennas on 'first-generation national security satellite constellation in LEO' (program unnamed)
claims.source_quote: Redwire has developed antennas, compatible with the Link-16 data link network used by the North Atlantic Treaty Organization ( NATO ) members and other nations, which can be used to facilitate the exchange of jam-resistant, encrypted tactical data from space in near-real time between military aircraft, ships and ground forces. These antennas are also being used for the first generation of a national security satellite constellation in LEO.
claims.source_filing: 10-K FY2023 Item 1. Business / Radio Frequency Systems

claims.claim_text: Redwire's Roll-Out Solar Array (ROSA) technology has flown on the International Space Station (iROSA arrays) and is positioned as a competitive power-generation product line for both LEO/GEO and deep-space missions.
claims.subject: Redwire (Power Generation)
claims.object_value: ROSA / iROSA solar arrays — flight heritage cited, future commercial+government pipeline implied
claims.source_quote: Our patented and award-winning Roll-Out Solar Array ( ROSA ) technology features an innovative roll-out design that uses composite booms to serve as both the primary structural elements and the deployment actuator... Redwire has completed over 5 successful power generation system deployments on flight missions in LEO, GEO, and deep space. These missions included our power generation hardware on the International Space Station ( ISS ), NASA s Imaging X-ray Polarimetry Explorer ( IXPE ) mission, and NASA s DART mission.

claims.claim_text: In partnership with Lockheed Martin, Redwire is providing the Orion Camera System for NASA's Artemis program — 'the eyes of Orion'.
claims.subject: Redwire (Avionics & Sensors)
claims.object_value: Orion Camera System for Artemis (Lockheed prime)
claims.source_quote: Redwire, in partnership with Lockheed Martin, is providing the Orion Camera System for the Artemis program. As the eyes of Orion, the Orion Camera System enables advanced vehicle imaging capability for Orion and the Artemis program.

claims.subject: Redwire (heritage portfolio)
